reasoning: The morning SELL thesis rested on an escalating Iran/Hormuz-toll MACRO_SHOCK layered on chip weakness, but that catalyst produced ZERO intraday follow-through — no fresh oil surge, Hormuz, or chip-selloff headline hit the 9:30-15:45 window.
